title: Phase 1: Embedding & Vector Search Infrastructure
summary: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #2229 --- ## 📝 Summary This PR implements **Phase 1: Embedding & Vector Search Infrastructure** for semantic tool discovery in the MCP Gateway. This enables natural language queries to find relevant tools (e.g., "database operations" → returns DB-related tools). ### Key Changes **Embedding Service** (`mcpgateway/services/embedding_service.py`) - Multi-provider support: OpenAI (text-embedding-3-small), Mistral, and local embeddings - Async embedding generation with configurable dimensions (1536 default) - Lazy initialization with provider factory pattern - Environment-based configuration via `.env` **Semantic Search Service** (`mcpgateway/services/semantic_search_service.py`) - Query normalization and preprocessing - Result caching with configurable TTL - Similarity threshold filtering - Batch embedding support for performance **Database Schema** (`mcpgateway/db.py`) - New `ToolEmbedding` table with pgvector support - `Vector(1536)` column for OpenAI embeddings - JSON fallback for SQLite compatibility - Cascade delete on tool removal - Alembic migration: `add_tool_embedding_table` **REST API Endpoint** (`mcpgateway/main.py`) - `GET /tools/semantic` with query, limit, threshold parameters - Returns ranked results with similarity scores - Integrated authentication and RBAC - Comprehensive error handling **Testing** - 50/51 tests passing in semantic search suite - Unit tests for embedding service, search service, and API endpoint ### Architecture Decisions - **OpenAI as default**: Highest quality embeddings (text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dims) - **pgvector for PostgreSQL**: Production-grade vector similarity search with HNSW indexing - **JSON fallback for SQLite**: Development compatibility without native vector support - **Lazy initialization**: Embeddings only generated when needed, avoiding startup overhead - **Provider abstraction**: Easy to swap/add embedding models without changing business logic ### Dependencies ⚠️ **Note**: Vector similarity search query implementation (`search_similar_tools()`) is pending Team B's completion. Currently returns empty results until vector distance calculations are implemented (~20 lines in `vector_search_service.py`). --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [x] Feature / Enhancement --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | ✅ | | Unit tests | `make test` | ✅ (50/51) | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | ✅ | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [x] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes **Testing the Feature** ```bash # Start dev server source .venv/bin/activate && make dev # Test semantic search endpoint (Swagger UI: http://localhost:8000/docs) curl -X GET "http://0.0.0.0:8000/tools/semantic?query=database_operations&limit=5" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
